answer.reason: The verses tell of his burning Jerusalem and the house of the LORD, carrying the people captive to Babylon, and releasing Jeremiah.

clauses.english: burned the house of the LORD and the houses of Jerusalem
clauses.quote: he burnt the house of the LORD, and the king's house

clauses.english: carried the remnant of the people captive to Babylon
clauses.quote: carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city

clauses.english: let Jeremiah go from Ramah, at the king of Babylon's charge
clauses.quote: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah
